backends.name: OptiScaler Enhancement Engine
backends.friendlyDescription: Core open-source enhancement engine enabling AMD FSR 4, FSR 3.1, Intel XeSS, and DirectX 12 frame generation in supported PC games.
backends.supportedGamesSummary: DirectX 11, DirectX 12, and Vulkan 64-bit games with DLSS, FSR, or XeSS support.
backends.compatibilityStatus: Supported across RDNA 1-4 (verified stable v0.9.5). Includes FidelityFX SDK 2.4 (FSR 4.1.2 INT8 for RDNA 2 FSR4-i8-2 & FSR-FG 4.0.2), XeSS 3.0.2, Fakenvapi 1.4.1, and Nukem dlssg-to-fsr3 0.130.
backends.installationInstructions: Downloads official SignPath-signed OptiScaler release archive from GitHub Releases, verifies SHA-256 checksum, unpacks to central staging, and deploys safely with automatic recovery backups.

backends.name: AMD FidelityFX Super Resolution (FSR 4 & 3.1)
backends.friendlyDescription: Official AMD spatial and temporal upscaling delivering crisp high-resolution edges on RDNA 2 (FSR 4.1.2 INT8) through RDNA 4 (FP8).
backends.supportedGamesSummary: 64-bit games supporting temporal upscaling across DX11, DX12, and Vulkan.
backends.compatibilityStatus: RDNA 2 (RX 6600) uses FSR 4.1.2 INT8 (FSR4-i8-2) & FSR 3.1.2; RDNA 3 uses INT8; RDNA 4 uses FP8. Managed automatically inside OptiScaler.
backends.installationInstructions: Provided directly inside the authorized OptiScaler Enhancement Engine release package.

backends.name: Intel XeSS Super Resolution (v3.0.2)
backends.friendlyDescription: Alternative DP4a temporal upscaling option useful for titles where XeSS stability outperforms FSR.
backends.compatibilityStatus: Supported via DP4a shader path on RDNA 1 through RDNA 4 through OptiScaler.
backends.installationInstructions: Included directly inside the authorized OptiScaler Enhancement Engine release package.

backends.name: DirectX 12 Frame Generation (OptiFG & FSR-FG)
backends.friendlyDescription: Generates intermediate frames in DirectX 12 games with HUD anti-ghosting protection for smoother motion.
backends.supportedGamesSummary: 64-bit DirectX 12 games without active kernel anti-cheat.
backends.compatibilityStatus: Supported on RDNA 1 through RDNA 4 for DirectX 12 titles. Automatically disabled when a game has native frame generation active.
backends.installationInstructions: Provided automatically with the authorized OptiScaler Enhancement Engine.

backends.name: AMD Fluid Motion Frames (AFMF 2.1)
advancedFileNames: AMD Adrenalin Driver Setting (Zero DLL Injection)
backends.friendlyDescription: Driver-managed frame generation inside AMD Software: Adrenalin Edition, ideal for DirectX 11 and Vulkan games without injecting game files.
backends.supportedGamesSummary: All DX11, DX12, and Vulkan games (including anti-cheat-protected titles).
backends.compatibilityStatus: Driver-managed capability on RDNA 2 through RDNA 4. Guided configuration only (never modifies undocumented driver registry keys).
backends.installationInstructions: Open AMD Software: Adrenalin Edition -> Gaming -> Graphics -> Enable AMD Fluid Motion Frames (or HYPR-RX). Disable in-game VSync and use Exclusive Fullscreen on RDNA 2.

backends.name: AI Neural Rendering Engine (DLSS-NR-on-AMD)
requiredDependencies: Experimental RDNA 2 HIP Runtime (AMD HIP 7.2 docs exclude gfx1032)
requiredUserDlls: nvngx_dlssnr.dll (>= 310.9.16.0 for CC model; >= 310.8.0.0 for HT model)
backends.friendlyDescription: Community AI Neural Rendering path supporting HT and fast CC models on DirectX 12 games. Upstream license requires personal acquisition from GitHub.
backends.supportedGamesSummary: 64-bit DirectX 12 games with neural-rendering / NGX hooks (experimental on RDNA 2).
backends.compatibilityStatus: Alpha 0.9.0 adds CC model (40-80% faster, requires nvngx_dlssnr.dll >= 310.9.16) and Superfast/Fast modes on RDNA 2 via experimental HIP path; Reference is unavailable on RX 6000.
backends.installationInstructions: Upstream license strictly prohibits third-party bundling or mirroring. Download directly from danielblnc/DLSS-NR-on-AMD GitHub Releases or connect an existing installation; Project Luma watches your Downloads folder automatically.

backends.name: Ray-Traced Reconstruction Engine
backends.friendlyDescription: Reconstructs cleaner ray-traced reflections and global illumination on RDNA 3 and RDNA 4 hardware.
backends.supportedGamesSummary: DirectX 12 ray-traced titles exposing DLSS-D inputs.
backends.compatibilityStatus: Native D3D12 support on RDNA 3 (RX 7000) and RDNA 4 (RX 9000). Not recommended on RX 6600 (RDNA 2).
backends.installationInstructions: Requires RDNA 3 or RDNA 4 GPU, official DLSS-NR-on-AMD installation, and legitimate local nvngx_dlssd.dll.

backends.name: AMDLSS5 Neural Upscaler
backends.friendlyDescription: RDNA 4 exclusive experimental neural upscaling catalog entry.
backends.supportedGamesSummary: DirectX 12 titles on AMD RDNA 4 GPUs only.
backends.compatibilityStatus: Explicitly excludes RX 6000 (RDNA 2) and older GPUs; RDNA 3 untested.
backends.installationInstructions: Available only for RDNA 4 desktop GPUs. Never offered for install on RX 6600 (RDNA 2).
